plugins.name: opencode-go-usage
plugins.description: Watch your OpenCode GO plan quota in a ZCode panel: rolling 5h, weekly and monthly usage bars with reset countdowns and time-elapsed bars, plus an /opencode-go command.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 在 ZCode 面板中查看 OpenCode GO 订阅用量：5 小时滚动、周、月三条进度条，带重置倒计时与时间进度条，并提供 /opencode-go 命令。
